description: List all files and folders in the Proton Drive trash. Returns {items, total, offset, limit, hasMore} (default limit 100, newest first, ties by uid); items are [{name, path, type, size?, storageSize?, modifiedAt?, uid, trashedAt?}]. Items come in a stable sorted order; each page is a fresh read, so changes between page calls can still shift items. Names are NOT unique in trash — uid and trashedAt tell duplicates apart. drive_restore/drive_delete accept the uid but refuse when the name is shared (the CLI cannot target one duplicate).
name: drive_list_trash
title: List trash
